desc: A modern classic in the European style, the 457 Premium has all sorts of flair. Its Turkish walnut stock has a decorative forend tip with Schnabel, while its hog-back stock has a mild Monte Carlo and a cheekpiece. Its 24.8 barrel wears irons, with a tangent rear sight and a fiber optic front sight, while the muzzle is threaded 1/2x20 in a more European standard.
